Archival Dispatch: 26 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Laurel and Hardy, Mysterious Circumstances, Fourth Tower of Inverness, and The Falcon

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: Laurel and Hardy, Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Mysterious Circumstances, JB Priestley, LP Hartley, Charles Dickens, Fourth Tower of Inverness, Jack Flanders, The Falcon, Gangbusters, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 61 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 61 dates and recovers 26 classic radio broadcasts spanning iconic film-comedy duos, BBC supernatural radio adaptations, pioneering 1970s stereo audio drama serials, and hard-boiled detective profiles: 6 historical broadcasts and BBC audio interviews from Laurel and Hardy (including Stan Laurel's autobiographical BBC interview, 'The Dance of the Cuckoos', and network comedy sketches), 6 BBC supernatural suspense plays from Mysterious Circumstances (1968, adapting literary masterworks by J.B. Priestley, L.P. Hartley, Francis Durbridge, and Charles Dickens), 6 serialized chapters of Meatball Fulton's metaphysical epic The Fourth Tower of Inverness (ZBS Productions, 1972), 6 historical actor and production profiles from The Falcon, and nationwide law-enforcement cases from Gangbusters.

1. Laurel and Hardy — Radio Sketches & BBC Interviews (1932–1953)

Primary recordings of comedy cinema's greatest partnership:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Comedy Sketch & BBC Feature
Laurel_Hardy_Dance_Of_Cuckoos.mp3 "Laurel and Hardy: 'The Dance of the Cuckoos' Theme & Song" 1932-10-14 The famous Marvin Hatley theme song with vocal lyrics by the duo.
Laurel_Hardy_BBC_Interview.mp3 "Laurel and Hardy: BBC Interview - 'The Life of Stan Laurel in His Own Words'" 1953-11-22 Rare BBC audio interview with Stan Laurel tracing his theatrical heritage.
Laurel_Hardy_Water_Rats_Appeal.mp3 "Laurel and Hardy: 'Water Rats Charity Appeal & Music Hall Reminiscences'" 1953-10-18 British music-hall charity broadcast from the Grand Order of Water Rats.
Laurel_Hardy_Marriage_Stan_Laurel.mp3 "Laurel and Hardy: 'The Marriage of Stan Laurel' Radio Sketch" 1944-02-19 Stan and Ollie's hilarious wedding chapel ceremony radio sketch.
Laurel_Hardy_Harvest_Moon_Flying_Deuces.mp3 "Laurel and Hardy: 'Shine On Harvest Moon' (The Flying Deuces Sketch)" 1939-11-03 Radio adaptation of their famous duet routine from The Flying Deuces.
Laurel_Hardy_New_Recruits.mp3 "Laurel and Hardy: 'The New Recruits' Radio Sketch" 1941-05-10 Camp routine parodying military enlistment drills.
